scope: Offline candidate audit only; not an enabled routing network or a source refresh. No generated trips or connector edges.
selectionRule: Highway ways with at least one retained source node inside the window. Crossing-only ways may be omitted. Whole-way coverage required for new candidate roads; unchanged original model ways retained in the offline union. This is not a complete road inventory.
horizontalCrs: Original OSM EPSG:4326; unchanged local tangent projection around [5.3235,60.395], Earth radius 6371008.8 m. No vertical inference.
verticalDatum: OSM highway topology has no verified vertical datum; grade-separation tags are preserved and uncertain ways excluded. Existing DTM NN2000 unchanged.
redistribution: OSM attribution and ODbL share-alike retained; all original IDs and checksums provided. This is an audit derived from the already pinned database.
